description: Defines the SystemConsoleSidebar class and related sidebar category classes for the Mattermost system console UI, using Playwright for testing.

classes.name: SystemConsoleSidebar
classes.description: Represents the sidebar component in the system console UI, providing methods to interact with and verify sidebar elements.

classes.name: SidebarSection
classes.description: Represents a section within the sidebar, allowing click and visibility checks.

classes.name: SidebarCategory
classes.description: Base class for sidebar categories, managing section links within a category.

classes.name: AboutCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for 'About' settings, including 'Edition and License'.

classes.name: ReportingCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for reporting-related settings, including 'Workspace Optimization', 'Site Statistics', etc.

classes.name: UserManagementCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for user management settings, including 'Users', 'Groups', 'Teams', etc.

classes.name: SystemAttributesCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for system attributes, including 'User Attributes' and 'Attribute-Based Access'.

classes.name: EnvironmentCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for environment settings, including 'Web Server', 'Database', 'Elasticsearch', etc.

classes.name: SiteConfigurationCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for site configuration settings, including 'Customization', 'Localization', 'Notifications', etc.

classes.name: AuthenticationCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for authentication settings, including 'Signup', 'Email', 'Password', etc.

classes.name: PluginsCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for plugin management, including 'Plugin Management', 'Agents', 'Calls', etc.

classes.name: IntegrationsCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for integrations, including 'Integration Management', 'Bot Accounts', 'GIF', etc.

classes.name: ComplianceCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for compliance settings, including 'Data Retention Policies', 'Compliance Export', etc.

classes.name: ExperimentalCategory
classes.description: Sidebar category for experimental features, including 'Features' and 'Feature Flags'.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the sidebar container, header, and search input are visible.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Fills the search input with the provided text.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin section by name within the PluginsCategory.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates a click on the sidebar section link.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the sidebar section is active based on its class attribute.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Retrieves a specific section within a sidebar category by name.
